general: TELL ME HONESTLY. DO YOU KNOW WHERE WE IZ GOING?
ME KNOW WHERE WE HAB BEEN. DAT HAB TA COUNT FOR SOMETHIN'!
WE HAB BEEN WALKIN' SINCE BEFORE IT WAZ LIGHT!
AN' WE WILL BE WALKIN' AFTER IT IZ DARK. DAT IZ DA ARRANGEMENT!
IF DIS ALL ENDS BADLY, ME WANT IT WRITTEN DOWN DAT ME SAID SO!
IT IZ WRITTEN DOWN. YOU SAY IT EVERY WEEK!
DO YOU EVER THINK ABOUT GOING HOME?
HOME IZ WHEREVER DA PACKS IZ!
DAT IZ A REAL SAD THING TA BE AT PEACE WIT!
YOU HAB BEEN QUIET ALL DAY!
ME WAZ THINKIN'. IT HAPPENS!
TELL ME AGAIN WHY WE TOOK DIS ROAD!
BECAUSE YOU ASKED, AN' ME SAID YES. FOOL DAT ME IZ!
ME WOULD NO HAB MADE IT DIS FAR ALONE!
NOR ME. DO NO LET IT GO TA YA HEAD!
HOW IZ DAT WOUND OF YA HOLDIN' UP?
IT HAB STOPPED BLEEDIN', WHICH IZ SOMETHIN'!
IF WE GET PAID, ME IZ BUYIN' DA FIRST ROUND!
YOU SAID DAT IN DA LAST THREE TOWNS!
DO YOU TRUST DA PEOPLE WE MET BACK DERE?
ME TRUST NOBODY ME NO CAN OUTRUN!
YOU CARRY TOO MUCH. GIVE ME HALF!
ME CAN MANAGE. ASK ME AGAIN ON DA HILL!
ONE OF DEZE DAYS WE SHOULD STOP FOR A WHOLE WEEK!
A WEEK. LISTEN TA US.
WHAT DID YOU DO BEFORE ALL DIS?
SOMETHIN' QUIETER. ME DO NO MISS IT AS MUCH AS ME SHOULD!
HOW MUCH MONEY HAB WE ACTUALLY GOT?
{gold}, AN' HALF OF IT IZ SPOKEN FOR!
SO DA ANSWER IZ NO, DEN.
SAY WE FOUND SOMEWHERE DECENT TOMORROW. WOULD YOU STOP?
ASK ME TOMORROW. ME IZ TOO TIRED TA BE HONEST TONIGHT!
WHO IZ LEADIN' DIS, EXACTLY?
{leader} WALKS IN FRONT. DAT IZ NO QUITE DA SAME THING!
ME DREAMED WE WAZ STILL WALKIN'!
DAT IZ A MEMORY ARRIVIN' EARLY!
ME HAB A DREAM ABOUT DIS PLACE. DO NO ASK!
YOU ALWAYS DREAM ABOUT DA WRONG THINGS!
ONE OF DEZE DAYS ME WILL DREAM ABOUT DA RIGHT ONE AN' YOU WILL OWE ME AN APOLOGY!
DO YOU THINK ANYONE IZ LOOKIN' FOR US?
SOMEBODY ALWAYS IZ. IT IZ WHO DAT CHANGES!
WE SHOULD AGREE ON WHAT WE DO IF IT GOES WRONG!
WE RUN. DAT IZ DA PLAN. IT HAB NEVER LET US DOWN!
ME HAB BEEN COUNTIN' DA DAYS!
HOW MANY?
ME LOST COUNT. DAT IZ ME POINT!
NOBODY WARNED ME DA BORIN' PARTS WOULD BE DA WORST!
NOBODY WARNED ME ABOUT ANY OF IT!
YA BOOTS IZ FINISHED.
ME BOOTS HAB BEEN FINISHED SINCE SPRIN'. DEY HAB NO BEEN TOLD!
ME KEEP EXPECTIN' SOMEBODY TA COME AN' TAKE CHARGE!
DAT WAZ DA JOB NOBODY APPLIED FOR!
WHAT IZ DA FIRST THING YOU BUY, IF WE EVER COME OUT OF DIS RICH?
SILENCE. A WHOLE ROOM OF IT!
WE IZ GETTIN' GOOD AT DIS!
WE IZ GETTIN' USED TA IT. DO NO CONFUSE DA TWO!
IF ME GO DOWN, DO NO CARRY ME. TAKE DA PACK AN' GO!
ME WILL CARRY YOU AN' COMPLAIN DA ENTIRE WAY!
ME HAB STOPPED ASKIN' WHAT IZ OVER DA NEXT HILL!
GOOD. DA ANSWER HAB BEEN DISAPPOINTIN' FOUR TIMES RUNNIN'!
SAY SOMETHIN' INTERESTIN'. ANYTHIN'!
DA WORD FOR A GROUP OF CROWS IZ A MURDER!
ME REGRET ASKIN'.
IZ WE DA GOOD ONES IN DIS?
WE IZ DA ONES STILL WALKIN'. ASK A HISTORIAN ABOUT DA REST!
DO YOU REMEMBER DA NAME OF DAT TOWN? DA ONE WIT DA BELLS?
NO. BUT ME REMEMBER DA BELLS!
ME WANT ONE DAY WHERE NOTHIN' AT ALL HAPPENS!
YOU WOULD BE UNBEARABLE BY NOON!
WE HAB NO TALKED PROPERLY IN WEEKS!
WE IZ TALKIN' NOW.
DIS IZ NO TALKIN'. DIS IZ WALKIN' WIT NOISE!
WHAT WOULD YOU BE DOING RIGHT NOW, IF NONE OF DIS HAB HAPPENED?
SOMETHIN' WIT FEWER HILLS IN IT!
DAT IZ NO AN ANSWER. DAT IZ A COMPLAINT WIT A HAT ON!
YOU HAB NO ASKED ME A SINGLE QUESTION ABOUT MYSELF IN A MONTH!
ME ASSUMED YOU WOULD SAY IT WHEN YOU WANTED TA!
DAT IZ EITHER REAL CONSIDERATE OR REAL LAZY!
WHO TAUGHT YOU TA FIGHT LIKE DAT?
NOBODY. DAT IZ RATHER DA PROBLEM!
ME HAB BEEN KEEPIN' A LIST OF EVERYTHIN' WE IZ OWED!
BY WHOM?
DAT IZ DA WEAKNESS IN DA LIST, YES!
DO YOU THINK WE HAB CHANGED?
YOU HAB GOT QUIETER AN' ME HAB GOT WORSE. SO YES!
IF YOU COULD TAKE ONE THING BACK OUT OF ALL OF IT, WHAT WOULD IT BE?
ASK ME SOMETHIN' EASIER. ASK ME ABOUT DA WEATHER!
NOBODY OUT HERE KNOWS OUR NAMES!
DAT HAB BEEN DA SINGLE BEST PART OF DA LAST YEAR!
WE IZ GOING TA RUN OUT OF MONEY BEFORE WE RUN OUT OF ROAD!
WE HAB BEEN IN DAT STATE SINCE DA DAY WE MET. KEEP WALKIN'!
WATCH OUT FOR DAT ONE. DEY IZ PLEASANT, AN' PLEASANT IZ EXPENSIVE!
NOTED. AN' IF DEY IZ SIMPLY PLEASANT?
DEN ME WILL HAB BEEN WRONG TWICE DIS YEAR!
HOW DO YOU SLEEP, OUT HERE, WIT ALL OF IT?
BADLY, AN' DEN ALL AT ONCE!
DAT IZ DA MOST HONEST THING YOU HAB SAID TA ME!
WE SHOULD DECIDE NOW WHO CARRIES WHAT IF WE HAB TA RUN!
YOU TAKE DA MONEY, ME TAKE DA WATER. NEITHER OF US TAKES DA TENT!
SAY WE FINISH DIS. SAY IT ACTUALLY ENDS. DEN WHAT?
DEN ME FIND OUT WHETHER ME IZ ANY GOOD AT ORDINARY DAYS!
ME DO NO THINK EITHER OF US IZ DOING DIS FOR DA MONEY ANY MORE!
SPEAK FOR YOURSELF. ME IZ DOING IT ENTIRELY FOR DA MONEY!
YOU COULD AT LEAST PRETEND TA THINK ABOUT IT BEFORE ANSWERIN'!
EVERY TOWN WE PASS IZ SOMEBODY'S WHOLE LIFE!
AN' WE IZ TWO STRANGERS WALKIN' THROUGH DA MIDDLE OF IT. TRY TA BE POLITE!
DERE IZ SOMETHIN' ME SHOULD HAB TOLD YOU A WHILE AGO!
DEN TELL ME ON DA ROAD. ME WOULD RATHER HEAR IT MOVIN'!
YOU CAN SEE DA TOWER FROM HERE IF YOU STAND ON DA BANK!
ME HAB SEEN IT FROM FOUR COUNTRIES. IT NEVER LOOKS ANY FURTHER AWAY!
SOMEBODY TOLD ME DA TOWER HOLDS DA NINETY-TWO DIMENSIONS TOGETHER!
LIKE DA STICK THROUGH A SANDWICH. DAT WAZ DA PHRASE DEY USED!
DAT IZ NO REASSURIN' AN' ME HAB THOUGHT ABOUT IT EVERY DAY SINCE!
WOULD YOU GO IN? DA TOWER, ME MEAN. IF SOMEBODY PAID!
ME WOULD GO IN. ME WOULD NO GO UP!
DEY SAY DA DOOR OPENED ON ITS OWN IN NINETY-NINE!
TWO BILLION PEOPLE DIED DAT NIGHT AN' A DOOR OPENED. DOZE IZ RELATED!
NINETY-TWO FLOORS OF DIMENSIONS AN' SOMEBODY HAB PUT A DEPARTMENT STORE IN IT!
DERE IZ CAMPIN' TENTS IN DA CORRIDORS. ME HAB SEEN PHOTOGRAPHS!
IF DA TOWER IZ A SPEAR, SOMEBODY THREW IT!
AN' WHATEVER SHE WAZ AIMIN' AT IZ STILL DOWN DERE UNDER ALL DAT ROCK!
DA FOUNDATION CHARGES TA GO PAST DA THIRD FLOOR NOW!
DEY CHARGE TA GO ANYWHERE. IT IZ NEUTRAL GROUND WIT A TILL ON IT!
DO YOU BELIEVE DERE IZ A GODDESS DOING DA PAPERWORK?
ME BELIEVE SOMEBODY PUT A BOUNTY ON ME FOR A BROKEN WINDOW. CALL DAT WHAT YOU LIKE!
EVERYTHIN' WE DO IZ WATCHED BY SOMEBODY WHO IZ BAD AT JUSTICE!
DAT IZ DA WHOLE CENTURY, SUMMARISED!
HAB YOU EVER SEEN A JUDICIAL GHOST?
ONCE, FROM A LONG WAY OFF. IT WALKED IN A STRAIGHT LINE THROUGH A WALL!
DEN LET US KEEP DOING NOTHIN' WORTH A STRAIGHT LINE!
A GOD ONLY EXISTS WHILE PEOPLE BELIEVE IN DEM!
WHICH MEANS DA LIL' ONES DIE OF BEING FORGOTTEN. DAT IZ A HORRIBLE WAY TA GO!
DEY SAY DRAGHI IZ A GOD NOW, AN' HE IZ A NUMBER!
EVERY NOTE IN YA POCKET HAB HIS NAME ON IT. DO DA ARITHMETIC!
DO YOU PRAY?
ME KEEP ME HEAD DOWN. IT WORKS OUT TA ABOUT DA SAME THING!
IF SHE WAZ KILLED, DA THRONE WOULD BE EMPTY FOR A FEW DAYS!
AN' EVERY AMBITIOUS IDIOT IN NINETY-TWO DIMENSIONS WOULD START CLIMBIN'!
YOU HAB THOUGHT ABOUT DIS IN MORE DETAIL DEN ME IZ COMFORTABLE WIT!
TWO THOUSAND AN' TWELVE. EVERYONE SAYS IT LIKE A DATE!
IT IZ A DEADLINE. DAT IZ WHY DEY SAY IT LIKE DAT!
DO YOU EVER THINK WE IZ LIVIN' IN DA LAST ORDINARY YEARS?
ME THINK EVERY GENERATION HAB BELIEVED DAT. OURS HAB DA ARITHMETIC TA BACK IT!
KEEP UNDER EIGHTY ON DIS STRETCH. DERE IZ A BUBBLE MARKED AT DA BEND!
ME KNOW. ME HAB DRIVEN IT BEFORE. ME WOULD LIKE IT NOTED DAT ME KNOW!
WHAT HAPPENS IF WE GO INTO ONE?
DA SAME DAY, FOREVER, UNTIL SOMEBODY DRIVES OUT OF IT AT SPEED!
AN' NOBODY OUTSIDE CAN TELEPHONE IN TA TELL US. WONDERFUL!
DERE IZ PEOPLE WHO LIVE IN DA BUBBLES ON PURPOSE!
YOU NO CAN DIE IN ONE UNLESS SOMETHIN' HITS YOU FAST ENOUGH. DAT IZ A BARGAIN SOME PEOPLE TAKE!
DEY SEND PIGEONS BETWEEN DA BUBBLES. ACTUAL PIGEONS!
WIT MEMORY STICKS TIED TA DEY LEGS. IT IZ DA ONLY POST DAT WORKS!
SOMEBODY SAID DA BUBBLES IZ GETTIN' BIGGER EVERY YEAR!
DEY IZ. DAT IZ DA POINT OF DA DEADLINE!
ME WOULD NO WANT TA BE DA ONE WHO LIVES DA SAME DAY FOREVER!
YOU ALREADY IZ. YOU SIMPLY HAB WORSE WEATHER!
EVERY ROAD IN EVERY WORLD IZ DA SAME ROAD, APPARENTLY!
DA ENCOMPASSIN' ROAD. TAKE DA WRONG TURN OFF IT AN' YOU IZ SOMEWHERE ELSE ENTIRELY!
IF DA ENGINE IZ CALIBRATED RIGHT, A TURN-OFF GOES TA ANOTHER DIMENSION!
AN' IF IT IZ CALIBRATED WRONG YOU ARRIVE SOMEWHERE WIT NO GROUND. CHOOSE YA MECHANIC!
DERE IZ A GOD OF ASPHALT, DEY SAY. HE MADE DA FIRST ROAD!
AN' WAZ DA FIRST THING RUN OVER ON IT. SOMEBODY HAB A SENSE OF HUMOUR!
A MAN BUILT AN ENGINE IN A CAMPER AN' MADE HIMSELF RICH!
HE BUILT IT TA GET AWAY FROM SOMEBODY. DAT IZ WHAT ME HEARD!
DO YOU THINK DA ROAD KNOWS WE IZ ON IT?
ASK ME AGAIN AFTER DARK AN' ME WILL GIVE YOU A DIFFERENT ANSWER!
DA ARCHIVISTS STOPPED A PARTY AHEAD OF US AN' READ OUT DEY MESSAGES!
DEY CALL IT MAKIN' THINGS PUBLIC. IT IZ READIN' SOMEBODY'S POST IN DA ROAD!
DA COLLECTIVE SELLS WATER AN' BUYS MEMORIES!
AN' EVERY OTHER LIQUID ON DA SHELF HAB SOMETHIN' IN IT. DRINK FROM DA WELL!
NOBODY HAB EVER SEEN AN ESOTERIC HEAVY INDUSTRIES FACTORY!
DA CRATES SIMPLY APPEAR IN DA WAREHOUSE WHEN NOBODY IZ LOOKIN'. ME HAB ASKED!
DEY GOODS IGNORE DA LOOP. MOVE IT SLOWLY AN' IT STILL DOES NO RESET!
WHICH IZ WHY ONE OF DEY KETTLES COSTS MORE DEN DIS VEHICLE!
DA GUILD IZ DA RICHEST FACTION AN' IT ACHIEVES NOTHIN'!
IT IZ TWO HALVES DAT HATE EACH OTHER HOLDIN' DA SAME PURSE!
VATICAN CITY FLOATS EIGHT HUNDRED METRES OVER ROME NOW!
AN' IT SHOOTS AT ANYTHIN' DAT COMES CLOSE. PROGRESS, OF A KIND!
WOULD YOU TAKE WORK FROM DA FOUNDATION?
ME WOULD TAKE DEY MONEY. ME WOULD NO SIGN DA RELEASE!
DA TRUCKERS KEEP DA BUBBLE TOWNS ALIVE. DAT IZ NO A LIL' THING!
DEY IZ DA ONLY FACTION ME HAB NEVER BEEN LIED TA BY!
DA NAGUKA CAME UP OUT OF A SOVIET BOREHOLE. DAT IZ DA ACTUAL HISTORY!
SOMEBODY DRILLED TOO DEEP AN' DA WORLD GOT WORSE. TWICE, IF YOU COUNT DA OIL!
HURT ONE NAGUKA AN' DA WHOLE SPECIES KNOWS!
SO DO NO. IT IZ DA SIMPLEST RULE IN DA WORLD AN' PEOPLE KEEP BREAKIN' IT!
DA VERDEN LAY EGGS AN' SPEAK BETTER DEN WE DO!
AN' DEY CAME FROM A WORLD DAT THREW ITS TECHNOLOGY INTO A SUN ON PURPOSE!
WHY WOULD ANYBODY GIVE UP EVERYTHIN' DEY HAB BUILT?
PERHAPS DEY FOUND OUT WHAT IT WAZ FOR. DAT IZ DA VERSION DAT FRIGHTENS ME!
HALF DA GOBLIN HORDES WORSHIP A NORWEGIAN BAND!
AN' DA BAND HAB BECOME GODS, BECAUSE ENOUGH OF DEM BELIEVE IT. DAT IZ HOW IT WORKS NOW!
DO NO SEPARATE DA WORDS OF A SPELL. EVER!
ME KNOW DA LAW. DA UNIVERSE SENDS DA BILL AN' IT IZ NO MONEY!
SAY IT IN ONE BREATH AN' JOINED UP, OR DO NO SAY IT!
CAMELCASE. IT IZ DA FIRST THING ANYBODY LEARNS AN' DA LAST THING ANYBODY RESPECTS!
ME SAW A GRIMOIRE EAT A NOTEBOOK ONCE!
DEN IT WAZ BADLY WRITTEN. A BAD SPELL SPREADS. BURN DA BOOK, NO DA SHELF!
STANDIN' ON A LEYLINE MAKES EVERYTHIN' STRONGER AN' NOTHIN' CONTROLLABLE!
WHICH IZ WHY DA GOOD MAGES IZ DA ONES WHO READ MAPS!
BREAK A LEYLINE AN' NOTHIN' WORKS DERE FOR A GENERATION!
EXCEPT DA DIVINE ONES, AN' DEY ANSWER TA SOMEBODY WIT OPINIONS!
LAVA DOES NO BURN YOU ANY MORE. IT DRAINS YOU!
UNLESS IT WAZ CONJURED. DEN IT DOES BOTH, OUT OF SPITE!
NOBODY CAN LEAVE DA ATMOSPHERE ANY MORE!
DERE IZ A MILL OF SCRAP GOING ROUND DA PLANET AT EIGHT KILOMETRES A SECOND. NOBODY IZ GOING ANYWHERE!
DEY IZ BUILDIN' ROCKETS OUT OF ARMOUR AN' VOLUNTEERS!
FREE OF CHARGE, BOTH DIRECTIONS, AN' NOBODY COMES BACK. REAL GENEROUS!
MEXICO LOOKS LIKE AFRICA FROM ORBIT NOW. IN ONE DAY!
AN' EVERYBODY WHO LIVED DERE IZ STILL DERE. DAT IZ DA PART PEOPLE SKIP!
SOMEBODY IN NEW YORK LOST DEY SOUL TA A BOMB DAT LEFT DA BUILDINGS STANDIN'!
DO NO SAY DAT WORD OUT LOUD ON DIS ROAD. NO WIT DA GUILD IN DA NEXT VALLEY!
ME GRANDMOTHER REMEMBERED BEFORE DA SKY BROKE!
ME CLAIMED TA. EVERYBODY'S GRANDMOTHER CLAIMS TA!
WHAT IZ DA LEAST WE COULD LIVE ON?
LESS DEN DIS. WE HAB PROVED IT TWICE AN' ME DO NO WANT A THIRD PROOF!
DO YOU EVER COUNT WHAT WE IZ OWED?
ME STOPPED. DA NUMBER STOPPED BEING FUNNY!
WE COULD TAKE HONEST WORK!
WE TAKE HONEST WORK. IT IZ DA PAY DAT IZ DISHONEST!
IF ONE OF US CAME INTO MONEY, WOULD DA OTHERS HEAR ABOUT IT?
YOU WOULD HEAR ABOUT IT. YOU WOULD HEAR ABOUT IT AT LENGTH!
WHO HOLDS DA FUND TONIGHT?
WHOEVER SLEEPS WORST. DAT IZ HOW IT HAB ALWAYS BEEN SETTLED!
WE HAB NEVER AGREED ON WHAT A FAIR SPLIT IZ!
WE HAB NEVER HAB ENOUGH AT ONCE FOR IT TA BE A REAL ARGUMENT!
SAY WE GET PAID PROPERLY, ONCE. WHAT IZ DA FIRST THING?
BOOTS. DEN A ROOM. DEN BOOTS AGAIN FOR WHOEVER IZ STILL COMPLAININ'!
WHAT WOULD YOU HAB MADE OF ME, IF WE HAB MET IN A TOWN?
ME WOULD HAB THOUGHT YOU WAZ SOMEBODY'S PROBLEM. ME WOULD HAB BEEN RIGHT!
HOW LONG HAB WE BEEN DOING DIS NOW?
LONG ENOUGH DAT ME DO NO COUNT IT IN WEEKS ANY MORE!
DO YOU EVER WANT TA TRAVEL WIT ANYBODY ELSE?
NO. DAT IZ ARITHMETIC. NEW PEOPLE GET KILLED!
ME WOULD TELL YOU IF ME WAZ THINKIN' OF LEAVIN'!
ME KNOW. DAT IZ WHY ME SLEEP!
YOU WENT AHEAD WITHOUT ME AT DA FORD!
ME DID. ME HAB BEEN WAITIN' FOR YOU TA SAY SO ALL AFTERNOON!
WE HAB NO HAB A PROPER ARGUMENT IN A MONTH!
GIVE IT A WEEK. DERE IZ ONE COMIN' AN' WE BOTH KNOW DA SUBJECT!
IF WE STOPPED TOMORROW, WOULD YOU SAY IT HAB BEEN WORTH IT?
ASK ME SOMEWHERE WARM AN' ME WILL LIE BEAUTIFULLY!
YOU IZ DA ONLY PERSON WHO KNOWS ALL OF IT!
AN' ME HAB NEVER ONCE USED IT AGAINST YOU. CONSIDER DAT!
TELL ME SOMETHIN' YOU HAB NEVER TOLD ANYONE!
NO.
DAT IZ FAIR. ME WOULD HAB SAID NO AS WELL!
WE SHOULD DECIDE NOW WHO TELLS DA FAMILY, IF IT GOES BADLY!
NEITHER OF US HAB ONE. DAT IZ WHY WE IZ OUT HERE!
HOW MANY KILOMETRES TODAY, HONESTLY?
MORE DEN YESTERDAY. LESS DEN WE SAID DIS MORNIN'!
WE HAB WALKED PAST FOUR VILLAGES WITHOUT STOPPIN'!
STOPPIN' IZ HOW WE LOST DA LAST THREE DAYS!
DA MAP IZ WRONG ABOUT DIS WHOLE VALLEY!
EVERY MAP HAB BEEN WRONG SINCE NINETY-TWO. DEY IZ HISTORICAL DOCUMENTS NOW!
WHICH WAY AT DA FORK?
DA ONE WIT DA TRAFFIC. TRAFFIC MEANS SOMEBODY THINKS IT GOES SOMEWHERE!
ME WANT A ROAD WIT A NAME ON IT!
YOU WANT A ROAD WIT AN INN ON IT. SAY WHAT YOU MEAN!
WE SHOULD BE SOMEWHERE BY DARK!
WE IZ ALWAYS SOMEWHERE BY DARK. IT IZ WHAT SORT OF SOMEWHERE DAT VARIES!
DO YOU KNOW WHERE WE IZ, EXACTLY?
ME KNOW WHERE WE IZ ROUGHLY, AN' ROUGHLY HAB KEPT US ALIVE!
DERE IZ WEATHER COMIN' OFF DAT RIDGE!
DERE IZ. WALK FASTER AN' STOP ADMIRIN' IT!
WE HAB BEEN GOING DOWNHILL FOR TWO HOURS AN' ME DO NO TRUST IT!
DOWNHILL IZ ALWAYS PAID FOR. SOMEWHERE AHEAD DERE IZ DA BILL!
WHAT IZ DA WORST ROAD YOU HAB EVER WALKED?
DIS ONE, EVENTUALLY. EVERYTHIN' BECOMES DA WORST ROAD EVENTUALLY!
DA TENT HAB ONE MORE SEASON IN IT. MAYBE!
IT HAB ONE MORE SEASON THREE SEASONS AGO. IT IZ A REAL BRAVE TENT!
WE IZ DOWN TA DA FOOD NOBODY WANTED!
DEN SOMEBODY IZ ABOUT TA DISCOVER DEY WANTED IT AFTER ALL!
WHOSE TURN IZ DA SECOND WATCH?
ME. IT IZ ALWAYS ME, BECAUSE ME IZ DA ONLY ONE WHO WAKES UP!
ME HAB MENDED DIS STRAP FOUR TIMES!
MEND IT A FIFTH. WE IZ NO BUYIN' A STRAP IN DIS COUNTRY'S PRICES!
EVERYTHIN' IN DIS PACK IZ EITHER BROKEN OR NEARLY!
SAME AS EVERYTHIN' CARRYIN' IT!
DO WE HAB ANYTHIN' FOR A FEVER?
WE HAB SOMETHIN' FOR A FEVER, SOMETHIN' FOR A CUT, AN' A GREAT DEAL OF HOPE!
ME WOULD TRADE DA LAMP FOR A DRY COAT!
YOU WOULD TRADE DA LAMP AN' DEN WALK INTO A HOLE. NO!
DAT FAMILY HAB BEEN AHEAD OF US SINCE DA BRIDGE!
DEN LET DEM STAY AHEAD. A ROAD WIT PEOPLE ON IT IZ A ROAD DAT GOES SOMEWHERE!
WOULD YOU TAKE A PASSENGER?
DEPENDS WHO IZ LOOKIN' FOR DEM!
EVERYBODY OUT HERE IZ GOING SOMEWHERE DEY WILL NO TALK ABOUT!
INCLUDIN' US. DAT IZ WHY NOBODY ASKS!
DO YOU TRUST A MAN WHO TELLS YOU HIS WHOLE STORY IN TEN MINUTES?
ME TRUST HIM TA BE LYING. WHETHER IT MATTERS IZ ANOTHER QUESTION!
SOMEBODY WILL OFFER US WORK IN DA NEXT TOWN!
SOMEBODY ALWAYS DOES. DAT IZ NO DA SAME AS SOMEBODY PAYIN'!
DA LAST PARTY WE MET HAB ONE FEWER DEN WHEN DEY SET OUT!
DEY DID NO MENTION IT AN' WE DID NO ASK. DAT IZ DA ETIQUETTE!
NOTHIN' HAB HAPPENED FOR TWO DAYS AN' ME IZ UNEASY ABOUT IT!
ENJOY IT. BEING UNEASY ABOUT PEACE IZ A HABIT, NO A WARNIN'!
WHAT DO YOU THINK ABOUT WHEN DERE IZ NOTHIN' TA THINK ABOUT?
DOORS. ROOMS WIT DOORS. IT IZ NO INTERESTIN' BUT IT IZ HONEST!
ME HAB STARTED TALKIN' TA MYSELF!
ME KNOW. ME HAB BEEN ANSWERIN' SOME OF IT!
SAY SOMETHIN'. ANYTHIN' AT ALL!
DERE IZ A BIRD ON DAT POST DAT HAB BEEN WATCHIN' US FOR A KILOMETRE!
THANK YOU. DAT WAZ WORSE DEN DA SILENCE!
DO YOU THINK ANYONE WRITES ANY OF DIS DOWN?
SOMEBODY IN DA FOUNDATION, PROBABLY. BADLY, AN' WITHOUT OUR NAMES!
ONE DAY ME WILL TELL ALL OF DIS PROPERLY, IN ORDER!
YOU WILL TELL IT OUT OF ORDER, AN' BETTER, AN' HALF OF IT WILL BE UNTRUE!
DO YOU WANT DA GOOD NEWS OR DA ARITHMETIC?
DA ARITHMETIC. DA GOOD NEWS IZ ALWAYS DA ARITHMETIC WIT A HAT ON!
WE HAB NO BEEN PAID IN FULL ONCE DIS YEAR!
WE HAB NO FINISHED A JOB IN FULL ONCE DIS YEAR. ME IZ NO DEFENDIN' DEM, ONLY COUNTIN'!
ME HAB WORKED OUT WHAT WE SPEND A WEEK!
DO NO TELL ME.
IT IZ MORE DEN WE EARN.
ME ASKED YOU NO TA TELL ME!
IF A STRANGER OFFERED US HONEST WORK AT HONEST PAY, WHAT WOULD YOU SAY?
ME WOULD SAY NO, OUT OF HABIT, AN' THINK ABOUT IT FOR A MONTH!
WE IZ GOOD AT DIS AN' NOBODY KNOWS!
DAT IZ DA BUSINESS. NOBODY KNOWS ANY OF DA GOOD ONES!
WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU TURN A JOB DOWN?
CHILDREN IN IT. DAT IZ DA WHOLE LIST AN' IT HAB NEVER BEEN ADDED TA!
DA LAST MAN WHO HIRED US KNEW OUR NAMES BEFORE WE SAID DEM!
DEN SOMEBODY SOLD HIM OUR NAMES. DAT IZ A SERVICE NOW!
DO WE HAB A REPUTATION?
WE HAB FOUR, IN FOUR COUNTRIES, AN' ONLY ONE OF DEM IZ ACCURATE!
ME HAB BEEN THINKIN' ABOUT DOING SOMETHIN' ELSE!
EVERYBODY THINKS ABOUT DOING SOMETHIN' ELSE. ON DIS ROAD, AT DIS HOUR, EVERYBODY!
WHAT ELSE COULD YOU DO?
ANYTHIN' WIT A ROOF AN' A GRIMORIE. ME WOULD BE TERRIBLE AN' ME WOULD BE WARM!
SAY WE STASH ENOUGH. WHAT WOULD YOU BUY?
SOMEWHERE WIT A DOOR ME OWN. DAT IZ DA ENTIRE FANTASY!
DA COLLECTIVE WOULD TAKE US ON TOMORROW!
DA COLLECTIVE TAKES EVERYBODY ON TOMORROW. IT IZ WHAT HAPPENS ON DA DAY AFTER DAT!
ME WOULD NO WORK FOR DA ARCHIVISTS!
YOU WOULD WORK FOR DA ARCHIVISTS IF IT WAZ WINTER AN' WE WAZ HUNGRY. SO WOULD ME!
EVERYTHIN' WE OWN IZ ON OUR BACKS!
EVERYTHIN' WE OWN IZ ON OUR BACKS AN' NOBODY CAN TAKE IT IN DA NIGHT. DERE IZ WORSE ARRANGEMENTS!
ME HAB STARTED GIVIN' DA BOOTS NAMES!
DAT IZ DA SECOND STAGE. DA THIRD IZ ARGUIN' WIT DEM!
WE SHOULD KEEP A PROPER RECORD OF DA ROUTES!
YOU KEEP SAYIN' DAT AN' DEN WE WALK INSTEAD!
WHAT IZ DA FURTHEST EAST YOU HAB BEEN?
FURTHER DEN ME WILL ADMIT TA ON A ROAD WIT PEOPLE ON IT!
DO YOU KNOW WHAT TODAY IZ?
IT IZ A WALKIN' DAY. DEY IZ ALL WALKIN' DAYS!
IT IZ DA SOLSTICE.
DEN IT IZ A LONG WALKIN' DAY!
WHAT MONTH IZ IT, HONESTLY?
ME KNOW WHAT MONTH IT IZ. ME IZ SIMPLY NO GOING TA SAY IT OUT LOUD, BECAUSE OF DA NUMBER AFTER IT!
SOMEBODY OUGHT TA NAME DIS ROAD!
IT HAB A NAME. EVERYTHIN' HAB A NAME. NOBODY USES DEM ANY MORE, DAT IZ ALL!
DO YOU THINK DA ROADS WILL STILL BE HERE AFTER?
AFTER? DA ROADS IZ DA ONE THING DAT WILL BE HERE AFTER. ASK DA TRUCKERS!
ELEVEN YEARS.
DO NO DO DAT. DO NO COUNT DOWN OUT LOUD!
EVERYONE TALKS ABOUT DA DEADLINE LIKE IT IZ WEATHER!
IT IZ WEATHER. DAT IZ EXACTLY WHAT IT IZ, AN' YOU NO CAN ARGUE WIT WEATHER!
SOME OF DA DIMENSIONS IZ ALREADY GONE, DEY SAY!
NO GONE. EMPTIED. DA PEOPLE CAME HERE. DAT IZ WHY DA ROADS IZ BUSY!
WHERE DO YOU THINK DA GOBLINS ACTUALLY CAME FROM?
DOWNWARDS. AN' DEY HAB EVERY RIGHT TA BE ANNOYED ABOUT DA DRILLIN'!
DA VERDEN WOMAN IN DAT MARKET SPOKE BETTER DEN ME DO!
SHE HAB SPOKEN IT FOR TWO YEARS. YOU HAB SPOKEN IT YA WHOLE LIFE. SIT WIT DAT!
DO YOU BELIEVE DA STORY ABOUT DA BAND?
ME BELIEVE ENOUGH GOBLINS BELIEVE IT, WHICH IZ DA ONLY PART DAT MATTERS!
ME MET A MAN WHO CLAIMED TA HAB BEEN INSIDE A PETRODEMON CONTRACT!
DEN HE WAZ LYING OR HE WAZ RICH. WHICH WAZ HE?
RICH.
DERE YOU IZ, DEN.
EVERYTHIN' RUNS ON OIL DAT USED TA BE A LIZARD WIT OPINIONS!
SAY DAT AGAIN IN A TOWN AN' SEE WHAT HAPPENS TA YOU!
ME SAW AN ANOKI PHONE ON A TRUCKER'S DASH. AN ACTUAL ONE!
DEN HE IZ SOMEBODY. DEY DO NO HAND DOZE OUT!
COULD YOU TELEPHONE A GOD ON ONE, DO YOU THINK?

SO WALK WHERE ME WALK AN' DO NO IMPROVISE!
IT IZ REAL BEAUTIFUL AN' IT IZ TRYIN' TA KILL US!
MOST BEAUTIFUL THINGS IZ MANAGIN' BOTH!
HOW LONG CAN A PERSON WALK IN DIS?
LONGER DEN DEY THINK. ONCE. NEVER TWICE!
KEEP TALKIN'. IF YOU STOP TALKIN' ME WILL ASSUME DA WORST!
ME IZ HERE. COLD, AN' HERE!
DA WIND IZ TAKIN' DA HEAT STRAIGHT OUT THROUGH DA COAT!
TURN YA BACK TA IT AN' WALK SIDEWAYS FOR A WHILE. IT HELPS!
EVERYTHIN' IZ DA SAME WHITE AN' ME NO CAN JUDGE DISTANCE!
DEN FOLLOW ME TRACKS AN' DO NO LOOK UP!
ME EYELASHES HAB FROZEN TOGETHER!
WARM YA HANDS FIRST, DEN YA FACE. IN DAT ORDER OR YOU LOSE FINGERS!
DAT CRUST IZ NO GOING TA HOLD ALL OF US AT ONCE!
DEN IT HOLDS ONE OF US AT A TIME. SPACE OUT!
ME FOUND RUNNIN' WATER. UNDER DA ICE, BUT RUNNIN'!
MARK IT. DAT IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA SHELTER!
DA SUN IZ UP AN' IT IZ DOING NOTHIN' AT ALL!
IT IZ DOING SOMETHIN'. IT IZ SHOWIN' US DA CREVASSES!
IZ IT POSSIBLE TA BE TOO TIRED TA BE COLD?
YES. DAT IZ DA DANGEROUS PART. KEEP MOVIN'!
SOMETHIN' CROSSED HERE. BIG FEET, NO CLAWS!
DEN IT EATS GRASS, AN' DERE IZ NO GRASS. SO IT WAZ GOING SOMEWHERE!
ME HAB STOPPED SHIVERIN'.
SIT DOWN. NOW. DAT IZ NO GOOD NEWS!
IT IZ DA MOST BEAUTIFUL PLACE ME HAB EVER HATED!
WRITE DAT DOWN WHEN YA HANDS WORK AGAIN!
HOW FAR TA DA TREELINE?
TWO HOURS IF DA WIND STAYS BEHIND US. DO NO ASK ABOUT DA OTHER CASE!
DA SILENCE OUT HERE HAB WEIGHT!
DAT IZ DA SNOW. IT TAKES DA SOUND AN' KEEPS IT!
WE SHOULD HAB BROUGHT MORE FUEL DEN FOOD!
WE SHOULD HAB BROUGHT MORE OF EVERYTHIN'. WALK!
ME WATER HAB FROZEN IN DA BOTTLE!
DEN PUT IT INSIDE YA COAT, AN' NEXT TIME DO NO FILL IT FULL!
DA LIGHT OFF DA SNOW IZ TAKIN' ME EYES!
DEN LOOK AT ME BACK AN' STOP LOOKIN' AT DA DISTANCE!
mountain: ME CAN HEAR ME OWN HEART IN ME EARS!
DAT IZ DA HEIGHT. IT PASSES, OR YOU DO!
ONE BAD STEP HERE IZ DA WHOLE STORY!
DEN TAKE GOOD ONES. SLOWLY!
LOOK AT DA DROP. JUST LOOK AT IT!
ME HAB LOOKED. NOW FACE DA ROCK AN' KEEP GOING!
WHATEVER IZ OVER DIS RIDGE HAB BETTER BE WORTH DA CLIMB!
IT IZ ANOTHER RIDGE. IT IZ ALWAYS ANOTHER RIDGE!
THREE STEPS AN' A BREATH. DAT IZ DA WHOLE METHOD UP HERE!
ME HAB BEEN DOING FOUR AN' A BREATH AN' ME IZ DYING!
DA PATH IZ A GOAT PATH AN' ME IZ NO A GOAT!
GOATS HAB BEEN DOING DIS LONGER. FOLLOW DA GOAT!
LOOK BACK. LOOK AT WHAT WE HAB CLIMBED!
ME WILL LOOK BACK AT DA TOP. LOOKIN' BACK NOW IZ HOW PEOPLE STOP!
DA WEATHER UP HERE CHANGES IN TEN MINUTES!
IT HAB CHANGED TWICE WHILE YOU SAID DAT!
ROPE OUT FOR DIS NEXT BIT!
DERE IZ THREE OF US AN' ONE ROPE. DO DA ARITHMETIC AN' GO CAREFULLY!
DERE IZ SNOW ON DAT FACE IN HIGH SUMMER!
DAT IZ NO SNOW. DAT IZ WHAT IZ LEFT OF A GLACIER, AN' IT IZ EMBARRASSED!
ME EARS WILL NO CLEAR.
SWALLOW, AN' SLOW DOWN. YOU IZ CLIMBIN' FASTER DEN YA BLOOD!
SOMEBODY BUILT A CAIRN HERE!
DEN SOMEBODY CAME DIS WAY AN' WANTED TA BE FOUND. OR WANTED US TA BE!
IZ DAT A PASS OR A DEAD END?
IT IZ A PASS. ME CAN HEAR WATER ON DA OTHER SIDE!
ME HAB NO BEEN WARM SINCE DA TREE LINE!
YOU WILL BE WARM ON DA DESCENT AN' YOU WILL COMPLAIN ABOUT DAT TOO!
A STONE CAME DOWN OVER DERE. NOBODY THREW IT!
DEN WALK CLOSER TA DA WALL AN' STOP LOOKIN' UP!
DIS IZ DA HIGHEST ME HAB EVER STOOD!
ENJOY IT FOR ONE MINUTE. DEN WE GO DOWN, BECAUSE UP IZ NO DA GOAL!
DA AIR TASTES THINNER. IZ DAT POSSIBLE?
IT IZ EXACTLY WHAT IZ HAPPENIN'. DRINK MORE DEN YOU WANT TA!
WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE?
ANOTHER VALLEY. DEN ANOTHER RIDGE. DAT IZ DA ARRANGEMENT ALL DA WAY EAST!
TWO HOURS TA DA TOP AN' ONE TA COME DOWN DA FAR SIDE!
DAT IZ OPTIMISTIC ON BOTH COUNTS AN' YOU KNOW IT!
DERE IZ CLOUD COMIN' UP DA VALLEY BEHIND US!
DEN WE GO OVER NOW OR WE DO NO GO OVER TODAY!
water: ME DO NO LIKE WATER ME NO CAN SEE DA BOTTOM OF!
DEN DO NO LOOK DOWN. PROBLEM SOLVED!
DA PACKS WILL NO THANK US FOR DIS CROSSIN'!
NEITHER WILL DA BOOTS. HOLD DEM OVER YA HEAD!

CLOSE TA SOMEWHERE WIT A HARBOUR, AN' HARBOURS HAB INNS!
SOMETHIN' MOVED OUT DERE. BIG!
DEN WE GO ALONG DA SHORE, NO THROUGH IT!
HOW DEEP IZ IT IN DA MIDDLE?
DEEPER DEN ANY OF US. CROSS WHERE IT IZ BROAD AN' SLOW, NO NARROW AN' FAST!
EVERYTHIN' IN DA PACK DAT MATTERS GOES ON TOP AN' WRAPPED!
EVERYTHIN' IN DA PACK MATTERS. DAT IZ DA PROBLEM WIT DA PACK!
DA CURRENT IZ STRONGER DEN IT LOOKS FROM DA BANK!
IT ALWAYS IZ. FACE UPSTREAM AN' SHUFFLE!
ME CAN HEAR A FALL DOWNSTREAM!
DEN WE CROSS ABOVE IT, AN' WE CROSS NOW!

DEN DERE IZ BEER, AN' NEWS, AN' SOMEBODY WHO WANTS PAYIN'!
DA WATER IZ DA WRONG COLOUR!
DO NO DRINK IT, DEN. BOIL WHAT WE HAB!
SOMETHIN' SURFACED OUT DERE AN' WENT BACK DOWN!
IT HAB BETTER THINGS TA DO DEN US. KEEP WALKIN' ALONG DA SHORE!

ON. CUT FEET OUT HERE IZ WORSE DEN WET BOOTS. ALWAYS!
A FERRY WOULD COST US HALF DA FUND!

DA TIDE HAB LEFT A WHOLE STREET EXPOSED!
DEN SOMETHIN' WAZ DERE BEFORE DA WATER WAZ. DO NO GO IN!
ME HAB NEVER LEARNED TA SWIM PROPERLY!
SAY DAT BEFORE DA CROSSIN', NO DURIN'. ROPE!
SALT IZ GETTIN' INTO EVERYTHIN' METAL WE OWN!
OIL IT TONIGHT OR THROW IT AWAY IN A MONTH!
DERE IZ A WRECK ON DA SAND!
DERE IZ THREE. LOOK FURTHER ALONG!
ME COULD STAND IN DIS ALL AFTERNOON!
YOU COULD STAND IN IT FOR TEN MINUTES AN' DEN YOU WOULD BE ILL!
DA FAR BANK IZ FURTHER DEN IT LOOKS!
EVERYTHIN' ACROSS WATER IZ FURTHER DEN IT LOOKS. ROPE!
SOMETHIN' HAB BEEN FISHIN' HERE. RECENTLY!
DEN DERE IZ FISH, AN' DERE IZ PEOPLE. BOTH WORTH KNOWIN'!
wetland: EVERY STEP HERE TAKES SOMETHIN' BACK OUT OF ME!

YA BOOTS WAZ FULL OF DA SWAMP AN HOUR AGO. DIS IZ DA SWAMP GETTIN' ACQUAINTED!

BREATHE THROUGH YA SLEEVE AN' DO NO DRINK ANYTHIN' STANDIN' STILL!
FEVER COUNTRY, DIS.
DEN WE CROSS IT QUICKLY AN' WE DO NO SLEEP HERE!
TEST EVERY STEP BEFORE YOU PUT YA WEIGHT ON IT!

DA INSECTS HAB FOUND US AN' TOLD DA OTHERS!
SLEEVE OVER DA MOUTH AN' KEEP MOVIN'. DEY LOSE INTEREST AT SPEED!

DEN IT IZ MORE FRIGHTENED DEN YOU IZ. WALK ON!

DEN FOLLOW DA REEDS. REEDS GROW WHERE DERE IZ A BOTTOM!
DA SMELL IZ COMIN' UP IN PATCHES!

DERE IZ A PLANK WALKWAY UNDER ALL DIS!
DEN SOMEBODY LIVED HERE ON PURPOSE. DAT IZ WORSE, SOMEHOW!

YOU WILL NO. ACCEPT IT AN' THINK ABOUT SOMETHIN' ELSE!
FEVER COUNTRY, DIS. EVERYBODY WATCH EVERYBODY!
ANYBODY SHIVERIN' SAYS SO, IMMEDIATELY, NO BRAVERY!

FROGS. THOUSANDS OF DEM. IT IZ DEAFENIN'!

WE IZ GOING DA DRY WAY. DA DRY WAY IZ DA RIGHT WAY!
DERE IZ A BODY IN DA REEDS OVER DERE!
DO NO LOOK AT IT AN' DO NO TAKE ANYTHIN' OFF IT!
ME WILL NEVER BE DRY AGAIN!
YOU WILL. IN ABOUT FOUR DAYS, AN' YOU WILL MISS DA MARSH BY DEN!

DEN FOLLOW DA CUTTIN' AN' THANK WHOEVER DID IT!
SOMETHIN' IZ FOLLOWIN' AT A DISTANCE AN' KEEPIN' IT!
DEN IT IZ CURIOUS AN' NO HUNGRY. WALK ON!
